articles.title: HNI Corporation Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2025 Results

articles.summary: MUSCATINE, Iowa--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- HNI Corporation (NYSE: HNI) announced today its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of 34 cents per share on its common stock. The dividend will be payable on March 11, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on March 2, 2026.
articles.title: HNI Corporation Announces Quarterly Dividend
